newsitem.title: GERMANY: German call money steady at just below 3 pct.
newsitem.headline: German call money steady at just below 3 pct.

text.p: German call money rates remained steady just below the 3.00 percent repo rate on Tuesday as liquidity levels stayed adequate, boosted by government tax revenues, dealers said.
Dealers said it was hard to predict the size of the Bundesbank's repo allocation on Wednesday because commercial banks' reserves at the central bank had been volatile recently.
"If the reserve data remain unchanged at today's level, the Bundesbank could perhaps withdraw a billion marks," one money dealer said. A total of 71.1 billion marks in repos expires on Wednesday.
Bank holdings at the Bundesbank totalled 39.3 billion marks on Monday, unchanged from Friday. The average for the month through Monday was also unchanged at 38.5 billion marks.
Borrowing from the Lombard facility was negligible after totalling 100 million marks last Friday.
The Frankfurt Interbank Overnight Average FIONA was set at 3.01908 percent on Tuesday, compared with 3.04300 percent on Monday.
